question: As per Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, which state of India has the highest per capita income for 2018-19?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa** had the highest per capita income in India for the financial year 2018-19, according to the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.
 
• The per capita income is a measure of the average income earned per person in a given area in a specified year.
 
• This metric is crucial for understanding the economic well-being and standard of living of the residents of a state.
 
• Goa's high per capita income is attributed to its flourishing tourism industry, mining activities, and a relatively small population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The per capita income is calculated by dividing the total income of the state by its population.
 
• It is an important indicator of economic performance and is used for comparing the economic prosperity of different states or regions.
 
• Other states with high per capita income include Haryana, Karnataka, and Kerala, but they lag behind Goa.
 
• The data provided by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation helps in policy formulation and economic planning.
